topic: Gyroscope as an attitude-sensing device, establishment of attitude reference by displacement gyro and rate gyro.
syllabus_extract: Gyroscope as an attitude-sensing device, establishment of attitude reference by displacement gyro and rate gyro.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS block diagrams and gyro sensor locations in IB; Instructor supervision during Q&A.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a gyroscope in an aircraft?
How does the conservation of angular momentum apply to flight instruments?
Why is an attitude reference necessary for the AFCS?

development.content:
Basic Gyroscopic Properties
Rigidity in Space
Precession Principles
Gyroscopic Torque
Construction of Displacement Gyro

Displacement Gyro Operation
Attitude Reference Establishment
Rate Gyro Functionality
Rate Gyro Construction
Damping Mechanisms

AFCS Integration of Gyros
Combined Displacement and Rate Use
Error Sources in Gyro Systems
Gyro Alignment Procedures
System Feedback Loops

summary_questions: Explain how a displacement gyro establishes an attitude reference.
Describe the role of a rate gyro in the AFCS system.
How do displacement and rate gyros work together in modern AFCS?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of displacement and rate sensing in this lesson will be applied in the next lesson regarding single axis and combined rate sensing.

pft_rows.syllabus: Rate sensing about three axes, single axis rate sensing, combined use of rate and displacement gyros.
